meta.name: azure-messaging
meta.description: Troubleshoot and resolve issues with Azure Messaging SDKs for Event Hubs and Service Bus. Covers connection failures, authentication errors, message processing issues, and SDK configuration problems. copy.tagline: 排查并修复Azure消息服务SDK的连接与处理故障
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在使用Azure事件中心或服务总线时遇到SDK错误需要快速定位
copy.tagline_en: Troubleshoot and fix Azure messaging SDK connection and processing issues
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you encounter SDK errors with Azure Event Hubs or Service Bus and need quick diagnosis

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会帮你排查 Azure Event Hubs 和 Service Bus 的 SDK 问题,比如连接失败、认证错误、消息锁丢失、无法接收消息等。它会检查资源健康、查阅 Microsoft Learn 文档、核对配置,并给出修复建议。
howto.when: 当你抛出 Azure Event Hubs 或 Service Bus 与 SDK 相关的故障时触发,例如连接失败、认证错误或消息锁丢失等。

say.text: Event Hubs 的 Python SDK 一直连接超时,帮我排查一下。
say.note: Claude 会按流程检查健康状态和配置。

say.text: Service Bus 队列的消息锁总是丢失,怎么解决?
say.note: 它会定位锁丢失原因并推荐文档。

say.text: Event Hubs 收不到消息,帮我查一下消费组和偏移量。
say.note: 它会用 MCP 工具检查命名空间和枢纽配置。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you troubleshoot Azure Event Hubs and Service Bus SDK issues, such as connection failures, authentication errors, and message lock loss. It checks resource health, searches Microsoft Learn, reviews configuration, and recommends fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about Azure Event Hubs or Service Bus SDK problems, e.g., connection failures, authentication errors, message lock loss, or similar issues.

say_en.text: My Event Hubs Python SDK keeps timing out when connecting. Can you help?
say_en.note: Claude follows the diagnosis workflow to check health and config.

say_en.text: Service Bus messages keep losing their locks. What should I do?
say_en.note: It will identify the cause and suggest docs.

say_en.text: Event Hubs is not receiving messages. Check consumer group and offset.
say_en.note: It uses MCP tools to inspect namespace and hub settings.
